findings.detail: The initial no-positive early return bypassed selector/depth checks for deny-only rules and depth-only hints. The final code treats only an effective empty rule set with no depth hint as refusal; nonempty deny/depth replies continue through comparison. Dedicated JSON-only regression cases were read.

The comparison initially applied fixed keys to all requested nested structures before accepting an empty reply. The final code strictly interprets the granted profile first, but interprets requested network only for enabled:true and requested filesystem only for nonempty rules or a depth hint. Complete refusal remains available for schema-valid nested unknown request fields. Aggregate request profile top-level unknown fields remain schema-invalid.

An intermediate repair still parsed requested network unconditionally for a nonempty filesystem reply. The final conditional requested-network parse matches the parent's category independence requirement. Both category directions and explicit empty/false unselected categories now have pure-data regression cases.
